introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Geology (0555), Paper 2, ORDINARY LEVEL, JUNE 2024. Duration: Two and a Half Hours.**

Instructions to candidates: Answer FIVE questions: choosing TWO questions from Section A, TWO from Section B and question 7 in Section C. (Note: Question 7 is compulsory.)

You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers.

regles_choix.texte: Question 7 is compulsory: every candidate answers it.

incertitudes: Aucun corrigé officiel : les réponses modèles sont rédigées d'après les notions classiques du programme O Level de Géologie ; elles sont à faire relire par un géologue avant mise en avant. Le sujet est une feuille à compléter (lignes pointillées) : les lignes ne sont pas reproduites.

Règles de choix : page de garde « Answer FIVE questions: choosing TWO questions from section A, TWO from section B and question 7 in Section C. (Note: Question 7 is compulsory) ». Codé : parmi 2 sur 3 pour SECTION A, parmi 2 sur 3 pour SECTION B, et une règle `consigne` pour SECTION C (question 7 obligatoire, toujours comptée).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) List TWO careers in Geology.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Any two of the following:

1. **Mining (economic) geologist**: locates and evaluates mineral deposits.
2. **Petroleum geologist**: searches for oil and natural gas.
3. **Hydrogeologist**: studies and develops groundwater (boreholes, wells).
4. **Engineering geologist**: advises on foundations, roads, dams and quarries.

(Other accepted answers: seismologist, volcanologist, palaeontologist, geology teacher or lecturer.)
themes: O Level Geology - branches of geology

questions.enonce_markdown:
(b) Define the following branches of Geology.

(i) Palaeontology. (2 marks)

(ii) Stratigraphy. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Palaeontology** is the branch of Geology that deals with the study of fossils, that is, the remains or traces of ancient plants and animals preserved in rocks, and so of the life of past geological ages.

**(ii) Stratigraphy** is the branch of Geology that deals with the study of rock layers (strata): their order of succession, composition, age and correlation from place to place.
themes: O Level Geology - branches of geology

questions.enonce_markdown:
(c) Outline TWO characteristics of Jovian planets.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Any two of the following:

1. They are very large (giant) planets, much bigger than the Earth.
2. They are made mainly of gases and liquids (hydrogen and helium, with methane and ammonia), with no solid surface.
3. They have low densities.
4. They lie far from the Sun, beyond the asteroid belt (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune), and are cold.
5. They have rings and many satellites (moons).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(d) State TWO characteristics of secondary waves.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
Secondary waves (S-waves) are seismic body waves with these characteristics (any two):

1. They are **transverse (shear) waves**: the particles vibrate at right angles to the direction of travel.
2. They travel **only through solids**; they cannot pass through liquids, so they are stopped by the Earth's liquid outer core.
3. They are **slower than P-waves** and therefore arrive second on a seismogram.
4. They are more destructive than P-waves.
